title: Confidence-calibrated abstention/deferral policy (triage safety)
description: Turn the calibrated model (oej) into a safe triage decision, not just an argmax. The worst failure in medical triage is confident-but-wrong, so below a per-class confidence threshold the system must emit 'unknown → consulta a un veterinario' instead of a class. Define how operating thresholds are chosen from the calibration curve/ECE, wire them into the contract's existing unknown path, and document the precision/coverage tradeoff (what % of cases we abstain on to hit a target per-class precision).
design: Pick operating points from the reliability diagram produced in oej. Prefer high-precision points for actionable disease classes; 'healthy' abstains toward caution. Keep the policy data-driven and re-derivable when the model changes.
acceptance_criteria: Per-class confidence thresholds derived from gold-set calibration; abstention rate + precision@threshold reported per class; 'unknown' path exercised end-to-end behind the triage contract; thresholds versioned alongside the model.

title: Acquire off-the-shelf dog-skin dataset + map to canonical labels + first YOLOv8-cls baseline

Fast/dirty baseline to prove the pipeline end-to-end; credible eval still requires the vet gold set (ll2). Needs Kaggle/Roboflow access.
notes: TRAINING PROJECT READY (ml/): label_map.json (coarse v0 mapping), prepare_data.py (stdlib, VERIFIED: 439 imgs -> 351 train/88 val, 4 canonical classes, correct ultralytics-cls layout), train_yolo_cls.py, requirements.txt, .gitignore. Not trained yet — user will reserve a Lightning AI GPU box and share SSH; then choose GPU + run prepare_data --download + train_yolo_cls. Baseline eval is directional; credible eval needs gold set (ll2).
close_reason: First YOLOv8n-cls baseline trained on Lightning AI T4: top1 val 0.852 on 4 coarse classes (351 train/88 val), ~2min. Directional only (noisy CC0 web data, tiny val). Weights on box: ~/petcare-ml/runs/classify/runs/petcare-derm-yolov8-cls/v0-coarse/weights/best.pt.

title: Make inference contract executable (JSON Schema + labels + urgency policy)

title: In-app data capture & feedback loop (consented, phone-style images)
description: The gold/train data is web-scraped and clean; real users upload phone photos in-the-wild (bad light, fur, angles) — a domain shift that can tank accuracy. Build a consented pipeline so real submissions become data: capture user image + minimal metadata (with explicit consent), optionally capture outcome/correction, route to a labeling/adjudication queue, and version accepted items into the gold/train sets on HF datasets. This closes the loop between the product and the model and is the main lever for closing the domain gap.
design: Sketch next with the user. Must respect consent/PII (pets photos may include owners/surroundings). Feeds ll2 (more real images) and future re-training; does NOT block the first gold set — avoid chicken/egg by bootstrapping the gold set independently.
acceptance_criteria: Consent + privacy handling defined; capture path from the app stores image+metadata; a review/labeling queue exists; accepted images flow into a versioned HF dataset with provenance; leakage discipline preserved (never mix into the frozen eval set).
close_reason: Integrated frontend analysis flow with the ML triage API, explicit compact consent, backend capture trigger, local saved history, and an admin capture-review queue. Backend HF sync and dataset guardrails are already in petcare-triage-service.

title: OOD input gate: reject images that aren't dog skin
description: A 4/5-class head ALWAYS returns one of its classes, even for a cat, a wall, a finger, or a blurry photo. Before classifying, gate the input: detect out-of-distribution / low-quality images (not-dog-skin, too blurry, too dark) and reject them with a 'foto no válida, vuelve a tomarla' response rather than forcing a bogus label. This is what makes the confidence numbers downstream trustworthy.
design: Reuse Hub OOD negatives (per ll2 scouting) + gold-set quality flags. Start simple: confidence/energy-based OOD score or a lightweight quality check; only add a dedicated detector if needed. Shares the eval harness from oej.
acceptance_criteria: Inference rejects non-dog-skin and low-quality inputs before the classifier runs; measured on the OOD/quality negatives from the gold set (OOD AUROC from oej) with a chosen threshold; wired into the contract's quality/OOD flags.

description: Use Claude Opus as a second reviewer for the PetCare ML Lead architecture decision. Compare options for keeping ML/backend separate from the frontend, sequencing requirements/data/contract work, and identifying risks before creating a new service repo.

value: LLM provider preference: use DeepSeek (user has an API key) for any LLM-based feature in PetCare (e.g. generating preventive recommendations text, understanding symptomNotes, or a vet chatbot). The core dermatology triage is vision-only via YOLOv8-cls and does NOT need an LLM. Model decision recorded in docs/ml/model-task-decision.md (YOLOv8 classification mode).

First PetCare baseline trained 2026-07-06: yolov8n-cls, 4 coarse classes (bacterial_pyoderma, fungal_malassezia, atopic_dermatitis, healthy), best val top1 0.8523 (epoch 24/50) on Tesla T4 (~2min). Data: yashmotiani/dogs-skin-disease-dataset (CC0, 439 imgs, 351 train/88 val). DIRECTIONAL ONLY: coarse lumped labels, noisy web data, 88-img val. Not clinical accuracy. Code in petcare-triage-service/ml/. PUBLISHED to HF (private): rosewt/petcare-derm-yolov8-cls-v0 (weights best.pt/last.pt + metrics + provenance + model card, AGPL-3.0).
